Vendored by tools/vendor_sources.sh. Only the files the sound models need (include closure of: plaits/dub/dub.cc plaits/dsp/engine2/string_machine_engine.cc plaits/dsp/chords/chord_bank.cc plaits/resources.cc stmlib/utils/random.cc stmlib/dsp/units.cc).

plaits (Emilie Gillet, MIT):   https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack @ f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86
stmlib (Emilie Gillet, MIT):   https://github.com/pichenettes/stmlib    @ d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481
dub.h, dub.cc (Narti Live, MIT) and his edits of four Plaits files:
                               https://github.com/Narti-Live/dub-base-Plaits @ e0146c498b6a7eba316666e573995715e3807e6f
                               (firmware/files/plaits/...)
